1.b4 c6 2.Bb2 a5 3.b5 cxb5 4.e4.strategy: Takes the centre and opens the f1-bishop at once: the loose pawn on b5 is attacked, and Bxb5 would pin the d7-pawn against the king. White plays for development and an open centre in return for the pawn.
1.b4 c6 2.Bb2 a5 3.b5 cxb5 4.e4.name: Sokolsky Opening: Schuehler Gambit
